Senses.Explanation: Asked “what is the phrase before sound?” Xuanquan Yan answers with the vocalization “un” (吽), and Heyushan Guanghui says, “it is just like not saying” (恰似不道). Huanglian directly answers, “before sound there is no phrase; after the sound, bring your question” (聲前無句，聲後問將來). Later addresses make contrary predicates within the same public record: one says “everyone originally has” the phrase, while the Blue Cliff Record says “the thousand sages do not transmit” it. These are attested answers and claims, not grounds for choosing an ineffable reading. Zen bends the temporal phrase into a recurrent interview prompt whose answers may themselves be spoken sounds; this entry preserves that observable use and the corpus’s own disagreement.
